name: Kasa Power Exporter
overview: A custom Prometheus exporter written in Python, designed to poll TP-Link Kasa HS300 power strips and expose instantaneous watts, volts, and amps.
details: The Kasa Exporter replaces the legacy SQLite-based daemon. Instead of running continuous loops, it listens for HTTP requests on a `/metrics` endpoint. When scraped by VictoriaMetrics, it uses the `python-kasa` library to fetch the instantaneous power data from the local network and formats it into standard Prometheus exposition format.
